failure_modes.description: A critical visual inspection tool (specifically region-of-interest cropping) fails due to an environment configuration error (KeyError), preventing the agent from accessing high-resolution crops necessary for detecting subtle abnormalities. This forces reliance on general-purpose VQA models which provide incorrect or insufficiently detailed findings.
failure_modes.needed_instead: Successful execution of the roi_crop tool to allow high-resolution inspection, or a fallback mechanism that triggers alternative high-sensitivity tools rather than defaulting to standard VQA.

failure_modes.description: The agent accepts negative or conflicting findings from general-purpose or specialized VQA models as definitive truth, even when the ground truth indicates a positive finding or a different diagnosis. The agent fails to recognize the potential for false negatives in model outputs or to cross-reference with other available signals when primary tools return negative or contradictory results, often relying on a verifier that lacks the visual resolution to correct the error.
failure_modes.needed_instead: A decision heuristic that weights specific positive findings from specialized models higher than general negative consensus, or mandates further investigation when model outputs conflict significantly.

success_habits.description: The agent invokes multiple distinct visual inspection tools to cross-verify findings and maintains progress by pivoting to alternative tools when a primary inspection method fails, rather than aborting the task.
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Without this habit, the agent would likely stall or produce incomplete analyses when encountering tool failures, leading to higher failure rates in complex diagnostic tasks.

success_habits.description: The agent performs direct visual reasoning without invoking unnecessary tools for simple visual identification tasks that the model can handle directly. It skips tools when 'no_candidates' are found or when the task is straightforward, ensuring efficiency and reducing potential failure points.
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Removing direct visual reasoning capability would prevent the agent from answering simple visual questions efficiently, forcing unnecessary tool use or failure.
